name: Instagram Comment Automation - Private Reply + Public Reply

parameters.content:
## Instagram Comment Automation

Graph API version: **v23.0** (verify against https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog and bump the `graphApiVersion` value used in the HTTP Request nodes if a newer version is required).

Env vars required (see README.md):
- INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
- INSTAGRAM_USER_ID
- INSTAGRAM_VERIFY_TOKEN

Credentials required: one **Postgres** credential (left unassigned on import — configure it on every Postgres node after import).

This workflow does NOT verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 header. See README "Hardening" section for how to add that check for your n8n version.

## Retry design

Each Meta call (Send Private Reply / Reply to Comment) uses onError = "continue using error output".
The Classify-Error Code node reads the status code defensively from several possible property paths
(error.httpCode / error.statusCode / error.cause.httpCode) because the exact shape can vary slightly
across n8n versions. **Verify this against your instance during the Testing Protocol step in the README
and adjust the property path if the classification never matches.**

429 / 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 -> retry (max 3 attempts, Retry-After header honoured, else exponential backoff)
400 / 401 / 403 -> permanent, no retry

If the DM succeeds but the public reply fails, the row stays dm_status=sent / public_reply_status=failed.
Use the companion workflow "Retry Failed Public Replies" to retry ONLY the public reply, never the DM.

nodes.name: Instagram Webhook Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you save the webhook subscription in the App Dashboard.

nodes.name: Instagram Webhook Events (POST)
nodes.notes: Responds 200 immediately (Meta requires a fast ack) then keeps processing below.

nodes.name: Extract Comment Events
nodes.notes: Ignores non-"comments" fields (e.g. mentions, live_comments). Splits a batched Meta payload into one item per comment.

nodes.name: Ignore - Invalid Event
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (malformed payload - missing comment_id or media_id).

nodes.name: Ignore Own Comments
nodes.notes: Also prevents infinite loops: our own public replies re-appear as new comments, but from_id will match our account.

nodes.name: Ignore - Own Comment
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (posted by our own Instagram account).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ig_processed_comments (comment_id, media_id, comment_text, username, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
ON CONFLICT (comment_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING comment_id, media_id, comment_text, username;

nodes.name: Reserve Comment (Atomic)
nodes.notes: Atomic dedup+reservation in a single statement. If the comment_id already exists, 0 rows are returned and nothing flows downstream for this item - no separate "Check Duplicate" step needed (that would not be atomic under concurrent executions). RETURNING deliberately echoes back every column downstream nodes need, so nothing has to be re-fetched from an earlier node by reference (Postgres executeQuery does not reliably keep pairedItem links for RETURNING rows).

nodes.name: Message Rules Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: this is the single place to add keywords, reorder rule priority, edit DM texts and the generic fallback.

nodes.name: Send Private Reply
nodes.notes: POST /{ig-user-id}/messages - https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/private-replies/. One private reply per comment_id max (Meta hard limit) - do not call this twice for the same comment_id.

nodes.name: Update Row - DM Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM echoue - reponse publique volontairement non envoyee.

nodes.name: Public Replies Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: the list of possible public replies lives only here.

parameters.jsCode: const list = $json.publicReplies; return { json: { ...$json, selected_public_reply: list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] } };

nodes.name: Reply to Comment
nodes.notes: POST /{ig-comment-id}/replies - https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-graph-api/reference/ig-comment/replies/. Only run once the private reply above has actually succeeded.

nodes.name: Save Success
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique envoyee.

nodes.name: Update Row - Public Reply Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique echouee. Utiliser le workflow "Retry Failed Public Replies" pour reessayer uniquement cette etape.

nodes.name: Handle Error
nodes.notes: Single terminal node for all error branches - makes failed executions easy to spot in the n8n Executions list.
